pulls.title: Align draft XML with canonical AID spec and regenerate outputs
pulls.author: nembal
pulls.body:
### Motivation
- Ensure the normative statements in `draft-nemethi-aid-agent-identity-discovery.xml` exactly match the canonical AID specification wording for implementation-critical behavior. 
- Make the repo build reproducibly generate the derived `.html` and `.txt` outputs in this environment.

### Description
- Restored and clarified normative parsing and record syntax: the TXT payload is a single semicolon-delimited string and clients should apply `trim()` semantics for keys/values. 
- Made discovery parsing normative details explicit: key comparison is `case-insensitive` and clients `MUST` recognize single-letter aliases for all defined keys. 
- Tightened PKA security wording to require providers to publish `kid` when `pka` is present and preserved the client `SHOULD` downgrade-warning guidance. 
- Inlined external RFC reference entries in the XML to avoid remote `xi:include` fetch failures and allow `xml2rfc` generation in this environment. 
- Files changed: `draft-nemethi-aid-agent-identity-discovery.xml` (derived `.html` and `.txt` were regenerated locally by the build but not committed).

### Testing
- Ran `make` which initially failed due to inability to fetch `https://bib.ietf.org/...` includes (network/proxy 403), and after inlining references re-ran `make` which succeeded in generating `draft-nemethi-aid-agent-identity-discovery.html` and `draft-nemethi-aid-agent-identity-discovery.txt`. 
- Ran `make lint` which completed successfully. 
- Commands executed (automated): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agentcommunity/agent-identity-discovery/main/packages/docs/specification.md -o /tmp/specification.md`, `rg` checks against the XML, `make`, `make lint`, `git add` and `git commit`.
